name: mirage
text: API quality data is built (CH58, in the next release): from then on the engine saves, for every API after every scan, how old its quotes are, how far from Pinnacle, how often it answered, how many lines it fed and how many ONLY it supplied. tools/api_quality.py turns that into a keep / drop table. ParlayAPI's odds websocket is the Business tier ($40 a month); I would not buy it before a week of this data shows it supplies lines nothing else does or is fresher than the sockets we already have: research/api_value_2026-10-21.md. The CLV cross-check inside the engine (CH57) is next.
